home.description: Discover the tables and kitchens of Algiers.

guide.title: Design guide
guide.introduction: Warm ivory, ink and a touch of saffron. The colours, type and controls that shape the interface.
guide.paletteDescription: The page and surface set the scene. Ink carries the text, and saffron draws the eye to the next action.
guide.bodySample: A shared table, fresh bread and the warmth of home.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.phoneDescription: Enter your Algerian mobile number. We’ll send you a code by SMS.
auth.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Algerian mobile number.
auth.otpDescription: Enter the six-digit code sent to {phone}.
auth.totpDescription: Open your authenticator app and enter the current six-digit code.
auth.otpExpired: This SMS code has expired. Request a new one.
auth.otpLocked: You’ve reached the attempt limit. Request a new code.
auth.otpConsumed: This SMS code has already been used.
auth.otpRateLimited: You’ve requested too many codes. Wait and try again.
auth.totpExpired: This verification has expired. Sign in again.
auth.totpLocked: You’ve reached the attempt limit. Sign in again.
auth.totpReplayed: This authenticator code was already used. Wait for a new code.
auth.totpConsumed: This verification has already been completed.
auth.otpDeliveryUnavailable: The SMS could not be sent. Try again.
